decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plan submitted therewith (A1_14_45BUR_002_Rev A, received 21/01/2014) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby approved shall match those used in the existing building and those specified on the application form.
Condition : 4 - The high level windows formed in the rear elevation shall be obscure glazed, non-opening (fixed) and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured fixed glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern and western walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension
